tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal kyai rdo rje sogs la sbyar ba'i rab gnas rgyas pa'i zin bris dang po'i las can 'jug bde bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya 'di nyid du rab gnas kyi rgyud dang mthun par kyai rdo rje la sbyar ba'i nyin bdun ma'am/ lnga ma'am gsum la sogs rab gnas rgyas pa'i lugs ltar mdzad par bzhad na sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i rab gnas dngos grub 'byung ba gtso bor bzung / 'on kyang rten bskyed sogs dngos grub 'byung ba nas gsungs pa bzhin la sku rnams so so'i mngon rtogs bzhin bskyed par spro na/ sde dge lhun grub steng gi chos grwa chen por mdzad pa'i yig cha de nyid la gzhi ltas rnam dpyod kyis ma 'khrul bar shes par bya zhing / de bzhin mchod rten bskyed chog kyang mchod rten rang rang gi mngon rtogs dngos grub 'byung bar gsungs pa ltar bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad ka yod na dang / med na de grwas gang yod na'ang de rang gi mngon rtogs kyis bskyed/ de bzhin khang bzang zhes rgyal po'i pho brang lta bu'am/ khyim phun tshogs rnams dang / rta babs sogs kyang dngos grub 'byung bar gsungs pa bzhin yin/ lha mkhar dang go khrab sogs kyang dngos grub 'byung ba bzhin/ bris sku'i gras thub pa'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis la bdud kyi dmag dpung yod pa de 'dra la rab gnas kyi tshe gang byed dgos kho bos ni sngar gtan nas ma shes pas mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyod dgos/ yul gru la rab gnas byar rung ba ni 'og tu 'chad rgyu bcas dgos par bkod nas/ ngag 'don dngos ni rang re sa lo yab sras kyi rjes 'jug rnams ni rten bskyed gral rim mngon rtogs bcas/ a mes zhabs kyi gsung rab gnas cho ga don gnyis lhun grub bzhin la dmigs bsal dgos pa rnams sngar kho bos nang so pu tra khang la rab gnas rgyas pa byas dus/ chos skyong dmigs bsal du bkod pa sogs dper byas nas shes dgos pas da lam gser 'phyang zhes pa me mo bya lo 'dir chos khri mkhas pa zil gnon la rab gnas kyai rdor ras bris dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang sbrags nyin bzhi dkyil 'khor sta gon the ba'i nyin lnga pa 'di byed skabs dpal sa skya'i phu kha'u lung pa nas mda' pa mtshams bar gyi lho byang lung par rab gnas rten bskyed kyi byin rlabs byed rgyu yin zhing /

de ltar rung ba yang bla med rgyud sde rnams las snod gzhal yas khang du gsung zhing / gzhal yas khang rnam snang yin pas na rgyu mtshan de'i phyir khrus gsol grub nas thog mar bsangs sbyangs kyi lugs pa bskyed chog ni/ stong pa'i ngang las gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya 'di nyid ni padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bhrūṃ las 'khor lo sogs rnam snang kye rdo rjer bskyed/ de zhu ba las gdan sa chen po'i dbyibs ji lta bar gyur pa'i nang du padma dang nyi ma'i gdan lnga'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir rigs lnga kye rdor bskyed pa gzhal yas khang bzhin rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur bar/ de nas bla ma yi dam nas nor lha'i tshogs rnams gsal bar bzhugs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur bar don gnyis lhun grub bzhin gnas gsum byin rlabs sogs dngos grub 'byung ba'i sta gon bzhin/ srid zhi dpal 'byor ma rdzogs nas/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi me btsal zhing sgrub pa ni 'dir rab gnas kyi gtso bor chos khri khang rnam snang du bskyed cing zhu ba'i dbus rigs lnga bskyed pa'i gtso bo dang rnam snang yin pas/ de'i sngags ni/ rdo rje gur las/ oṃ shā shwa ta pa ra ma shā shwa ta e hye hi/ dzi na dz-ika phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis dpal 'bar thab la lan gsum bskor ba nas bzung gzhung bzhin la/ spel tshig ni/ dpal ldan sa skya'i chos khri khang chen rten dang brten pa thog drangs rten rab tu gnas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes sbyar/ 'das pa'i me lha bskyed skabs de lta bu'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du paṃ las padma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i gdan bhrūṃ dzi na dz-ika na maḥ rnam par snang mdzad kyai rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar/

steng zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis gnag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du mdzes pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas brgyad 'khor lo/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ dbu re re la sogs nas ldan pa nyid bar rgyun bzhin/ laṃ lo tsa na na maḥde'i pang na yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug sogs nas gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i mig tu sogs/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rab gnas kyi rten gyi ye shes pa mar me gcig las gnyis mched tshul du byon pa'i ye shes pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dmigs med sogs/ bhā ga wān/ bai ro tsa na buddha lo tsa na sa ma ya sogs 'khyud pa nyid rnam par snang mdzad dag par byas sogs bstod pa dgug gzhug chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gnyis 'dzum zhing zhi ba sogs/ oṃ shā shwa sogs/ byon zan spel tshig gong bzhin/ oṃ bha ga wan/ ma hā ka ru ṇi ka bai ro tsa na buddha lo tsa ne sa pa ri wā ra sngon 'gro'i mchod pa/ oṃ laṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags/ rnam par snang mdzad sogs/ bstod pa de'i sngags gong bzhin gsum re sngon 'gro'i 'bul tshan/ rdzas gzhan bcu gcig til brgya tshar/ gshegs skyems/ phyi mchod mtshan sngags gong bzhin/ nang mchod la/ oṃ shā shwa sogs rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i sogs yid mchod dang / bstod thung gong bzhin/ bstod ring 'gro ba rgyud lnga/ gtor ma byin rlabs mtshan sngags gcig sngon 'gros chu bzhi'i mtshan sngags la oṃ a kā ro btags pa'i 'bul sngags/

oṃ badzra puṣpe aḥhūm̐ sogs/ oṃ laṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rnam par snang mdzad yab yum gyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /dkar mo ri dwags sogs/ rnam par snang mdzad sogs yid mchod dang / bstod thung / mchod sbyin gtor ma nas kun 'grub shog bar/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan sogs/ dpal ldan sa skya'i chos khri khang chen po sogs nas bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ zhes sbyar ye shes pa rten gyi lha'i thugs kar gshegs sogs nas/ 'jigs rten pa'i me lha'i dam ye gshegs gsol bar byas la/ nang du 'ong nas/ bde gshegs rigs lnga bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes sogs snyan gsan dbab pa sogs/ 'phros rnams dngos grub 'byung ba bzhin te rab gnas sta gon gyi skabs so// ༈ /rab gnas dngos gzhi'ang / dngos grub 'byung ba bzhin la/ brtan bzhugs rjes kyi gdan gsum tshang ba'i brtan bzhugs tshigs bcad dang / so sor mchod phreng rgyas pa dpal 'byor rgya mtsho bzhin da lam bstod pa'i skabs su/ kun gyi byed po bla ma yin/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i rjes su/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum rnams/ /'gro ba'i don du rigs gsum skur bstan pa'i/ /rnam sprul rgyun chad med par byon pa'i rgyud/ /sa skya'i gdung rabs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes a mes zhabs kyi gsung bzhin la rjes tshig cung zad bsgyur ba/ rigs rus cho 'brangs ldan zhing ting 'dzin gyis/ /brgyud 'khrungs dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po bla ma mchog khyod la/ /sgo gsum gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan bgrang yas pa/ /gang gi thugs la dgos pa med par gnas/ /'gro kun dga' ba'i bdud rtsi'i 'od dkar can/ /dge legs kunda'i snying po la phyag 'tshal/ /khyod kyi rdo rje gsum las bskyed gyur pa'i/ /legs byas bsod nams dpag med kyis 'phangs pas/

/myang 'das rtse mor phyin pa'i dam pa mchog /rtsod med mkhas pa'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal/ /bde gshegs bstan pa'i gsung rab seng ge'i sgras/ /ltas ngan ri dwags mtha' dag skrag par mdzad/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pa ji bzhin legs sgrub pa'i/ /mtshungs med grags pa rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal/ /rtog ge ngan pa'i rgol ba thams cad bzlog /rlom pas khengs pa'i rtog ge zil gyis gnon/ /mkhas pa'i grags pas sa steng thams cad khyab/ /'jigs bral khyod la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /grags ldan kun tu bzang po'i rnam par sprul/ /rtsod pa'i dus 'dir thams cad mkhyen par grags/ /'dzam gling bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol ba'i/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes cung zad tshig bsgyur ba de rnams la dril gsil gdangs bcas/ de nas dril gsil bzhag la/ bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal gyi sku bstod yongs rdzogs gdangs bcas rgyun bzhin/ yang dril gsil gyi chos sku nam mkha' sogs so/ /mnga' dbul la'ang sangs rgyas sprul sku'i rnam pa can la longs sku'i chas yod pa jo bo shākya'i mu ne lta bu la sprul longs kyi mnga' dbul gang yang byed ma shes pas mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyod par zhu/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg mi btsal ba gong bzhin la gso ba'i dgang blugs rin chen khu tshur gyis bzung / thab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rgyas pa'i thab khung ser po rgyar khru gnyis pa/ zabs su khru gang pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa kha khyer ram/ mu ran la rin po che'i phreng bas mtshan pa zer ba ma gtogs 'dra'o/ /me 'bar ba'i zhes sogs nas zhal gyi dkyil 'khor ser po las 'od zer ser po 'phro ba zer ba dang / rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan zhes zer ba dang / spel tshig ni/ rdze btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa gdung rgyud lha sde/

mi sde 'khor 'bangs mnga' thang dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams rigs rgyud dpal 'byor sogs legs pa'i yon tan thams cad puṣṭi ཾku ru oṃ/ 'das pa'i me lha gong bzhin la/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan lha thams cad 'dzum zhing tshim pa 'od zer ser po 'phro ba dang gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i sgo nas bar de 'phros tshang ma gong bzhin la/ dur wa/ zas mchog 'bras sum brgya dang brgyad/ rdzas gzhan rnams bcu gcig re/ nyin rjes mar ku sha rdzogs nas/ 'o thug sgrub pa ni/ oṃ shā shwa sogs lnga brgya tsam bzla dgos sam gong ltar 'o ma khol nges bar/ de nas 'khur ba sogs yo byad gzhan dang bcas par dmigs nas mdzod rgya/ sngags sogs dpal 'byor rgya mtsho bzhin/ 'o thug de'i phud rten gyi drung du'ang snod gcig bskyal/ byings nas dgang blugs kyis brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul sngags shā shwa sogs bza' bca' gzhan nas kyang sngags des bcu gcig tsam phul mthar gshegs skyems man chad gong bzhin la khyad chos sbyor tshul rigs 'gre/ nang du 'ong nas sngags kyi mnga' 'bul man chad dngos grub 'byung ba bzhin no/ /de bzhin bde mchog gsang 'dus phur pa sogs la'ang khyad chos so sor ma 'dres par byas nas spyir btang ni 'di nyid rang yin zhing / rab gnas grub pas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rang rang gzhung bzhin bya dgos pas 'dir sbyor dngos rjes gsum kyai rdor zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sor bzhag la/ spel tshig ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa gdung rgyud/ lha sde/ mi sde/ 'khor 'bang mnga' thang dang bcas pa'i las nyon sdig sgrib nyes ltung / nad gdon byad kha rbod gtong / grib dang mi gtsang ba mi kha sogs 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dang / cho ga lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nongs pa'i tshogs thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes sbyar ro// //zhes pa 'di'ang sa skya pa kun blos sngon du mchod stong 'dzam gling 'od gsal dang nang so pu tra khang la rab gnas rgyas pa byas skabs zin bris nyung ngu re byas yod kyang /

slad nas rab gnas rgyas pa byed tshul 'di la gzhi lhas nas gnang rgyur gser 'phyang lo shar ma khad la sbyar ba'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 kun dga' blo gros/ kye rdor sogs la sbyar ba'i rab gnas rgyas pa'i zin bris/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
